title: TMC moves Calcutta High Court challenging pre-dawn police raid at Abhishek Banerjee's residence
description: The Calcutta High Court on Monday sought the State's response to a petition filed by the All India Trinamool Congress (TMC) challenging the legality of a raid carried out by the police in the early hours of June 13 at TMC leader Abhishek Banerjee's residence. Justice Saugata Bhattacharya also ordered the preservation of CCTV footage from Banerjee's residence as well as audio visual records with the police of the June 13 search operation.
